cross_process_task_status.root_cause: taskRegistry is a module-scope in-memory Map; each separate node CLI invocation has a fresh empty registry. generate-video + task-status only share state within ONE long-lived process (the MCP server). This is a PRE-EXISTING design limitation (the prior stub had it too; never live-tested before). The in-process async contract itself is validated by the new test (gemini generate-video returns an async task envelope and task-status reports terminal state) and by the real MP4 on disk proving the async job completed.
